execution: Unmodified installed CRAN mgcv 1.9-4 smooth.construct, smoothCon and fixed-SP gam. Deterministic decimal grid, factor levels, boundary coordinates, interior knots, responses and held-out observations generated only by the source probe and frozen in the capture; ordinary tests are static and require no R.
scope: 76 source cases: ordinary fs/sz with so/sf/sw over six boundary domains, with and without a factor; four additional no-factor fs/sz so/sw fits with explicit per-term SP. Raw constructor, constrained constructor and actual fixed-SP fitting acceptance/errors; base ncol/rank/nullity and offset; predictions, fitted values, prediction covariance, EDF, design/penalty operators. Runtime comparisons use transported designs/penalties and predicted functions/covariances, never raw eigenvectors or coefficients.

domains.mixed: Free outer boundary and known-valued hole.
domains.multiple_free: Free outer boundary and free hole.
domains.all_known: Known-valued outer boundary and known-valued hole.
domains.outer_known: Known-valued outer boundary and free hole.

classification: With an actual factor, so containing any free boundary has multiple penalties and is rejected by fs/sz; sf with two free boundaries is rejected by the same guard.
Full-rank sw inside fs fails upstream subscript assignment because 1:null.d becomes 1:0 at null.d=0. Fully known so has the same full-rank failure in fs.
With an actual factor, so/sz with all boundaries known is accepted with its sole full-rank interior penalty.
sf with all boundaries known has no free coefficients and fails in the base constructor.
Single-penalty sf is accepted in fs/sz; full-rank sw is accepted in sz.
Without an actual factor, fs/sz delegates directly to the requested base constructor before the multiple-penalty and full-rank factor guards.
No-factor delegation preserves explicit per-term smoothing parameters; their positive source values fix the associated smoothing parameters.
Soap base offsets are retained by no-factor delegation. Actual factor constructor reconstruction discards the X offset attribute; captures record this source behavior explicitly.
tolerances: Existing ordinary-soap-factor tolerances retained: fit/prediction/covariance/EDF 4e-5; design transport 2e-7; penalty transport 3e-6.
